      "source": [
        "company_analysis = (\n",

        "\n",
        "company_analysis['Percentage'] = (\n",
        "    company_analysis['Incident_Count'] / len(df) * 100\n",
        ").round(2)\n",
        "\n",
        "company_analysis"
      ],

        "## 5. KPI / Executive Summary"

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "kpi = {\n",
        "    'Total Incidents': len(df),\n",
        "    'Total Days Lost': df['Days_Lost'].sum(),\n",
        "    'Critical Incidents': (df['Severity'] == 'Critical').sum(),\n",
        "    'High Incidents': (df['Severity'] == 'High').sum(),\n",
        "    'PPE Used': (df['PPE_Used'] == 'Yes').sum(),\n",
        "    'PPE Incomplete': (df['PPE_Used'] == 'Incomplete').sum(),\n",
        "    'Average Days Lost': round(df['Days_Lost'].mean(), 2)\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "kpi"

    {

      "source": [

      }

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "factor_analysis = df['Contributing_Factor'].value_counts().reset_index()\n",
        "factor_analysis.columns = ['Contributing_Factor', 'Incident_Count']\n",
        "\n",
        "factor_analysis['Percentage'] = (\n",
        "    factor_analysis['Incident_Count'] / len(df) * 100\n",
        ").round(2)\n",
        "\n",
        "factor_analysis"
      ],

      "source": [

        "\n",

        "    factor_days.values\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title('Average Days Lost by Contributing Factor')\n",
        "plt.xlabel('Average Days Lost')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Contributing Factor')\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [

        "    ppe_analysis['Incident_Count'] / len(df) * 100\n",
        ").round(2)\n",

        "plt.title('Severity Distribution by PPE Status')\n",

        "plt.xticks(rotation=0)\n",
        "plt.legend(title='Severity')\n",

        "plt.show()"

        "## 13. Critical Incident Analysis"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "45IDyxTvte_B"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "critical_analysis = (\n",
        "    df[df['Severity'] == 'Critical']\n",
        "    .groupby('Incident_Type')['Days_Lost']\n",
        "    .agg(['count', 'sum', 'mean'])\n",
        "    .reset_index()\n",
        "    .sort_values('count', ascending=False)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "critical_analysis.columns = [\n",
        "    'Incident_Type',\n",
        "    'Critical_Incidents',\n",
        "    'Total_Days_Lost',\n",
        "    'Average_Days_Lost'\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "critical_analysis.round(2)"
      ],

      "source": [
        "critical_factor_analysis = (\n",
        "    df[df['Severity'] == 'Critical']\n",
        "    ['Contributing_Factor']\n",
        "    .value_counts()\n",
        "    .reset_index()\n",

        "critical_factor_analysis.columns = [\n",
        "    'Contributing_Factor',\n",
        "    'Critical_Incidents'\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "critical_factor_analysis['Percentage'] = (\n",
        "    critical_factor_analysis['Critical_Incidents']\n",
        "    / critical_factor_analysis['Critical_Incidents'].sum()\n",
        "    * 100\n",
        ").round(2)\n",
        "\n",
        "critical_factor_analysis"

      "source": [
        "critical_factors = (\n",
        "    pd.crosstab(df['Contributing_Factor'], df['Severity'])\n",
        "    [['Critical']]\n",
        "    .query('Critical > 0')\n",
        "    .sort_values('Critical', ascending=False)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "critical_factors"
      ],

        "## 14. Shift Analysis"

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "shift_analysis = df['Shift'].value_counts().reset_index()\n",
        "shift_analysis.columns = ['Shift', 'Incident_Count']\n",
        "\n",
        "shift_analysis['Percentage'] = (\n",
        "    shift_analysis['Incident_Count'] / len(df) * 100\n",
        ").round(2)\n",
        "\n",
        "shift_analysis"
      ],
